message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically takes around **6 to 7 hours** under normal traffic conditions. The distance is roughly 380–400 miles (≈ 610–640 km) via I‑5 S, and the actual time can vary depending on weather, road work, and peak‑hour congestion. If you’re planning a trip, it’s a good idea to check real‑time traffic updates and consider leaving early to avoid rush hour on the way out of the Bay Area.
